mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative S&P 500 returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 195 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 3.0%, it indicates a high-inflation monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 195 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing and broader economic activity, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 115, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 115, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative S&P 500 returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market boom (HOUST > 1850 thousand units), a rising retail sales (RSAFS) above $340 billion signals strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: housing market boom and strong retail sales
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1850 and RSAFS > 340000, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
